items.title:
NEW — POSITIONAL SLOTS: `when`, `swap` and `bind_each` as `Slot` VALUES placed at an ANCHOR, instead of parent methods that APPEND — today each is `parent.when(..)` / `parent.swap(..)` / `parent.bind_each(..)` and its content lands at the END of the parent, so a conditional or a keyed run between static siblings costs a wrapper element per region (and the `Source` / `Source>` child arms re-order themselves behind their siblings on the first change, A71). `Slot` already IS the child contract (B268: `View`, `str`, `List`, and a `Source` of each — a signal is admitted by a blanket impl over the bound, not by a type-system special case), so `each(items, key, row)`, `when(more, \|\| footer)` and `swap(route, render)` RETURNING values that `impl .. with Slot` and place themselves at a marker node (`Element::insert_before`, which `std::dom` lacks) put fragments (A46), conditionals and keyed runs in position as ordinary children — `
    {header}{each(..)}{when(..)}
` — with no container
items.discussion: the owner's ask (2026-09-11): a child trait that admits an array of views as one child, positional conditionals, positional `bind_each`, and signals without special handling; the trait exists (B268 made `Slot` the contract) — what is missing is POSITION and the VALUE form. A71's anchor is the mechanism's first brick and A46's fragment rides the same anchor; B253 (a bare trait in RETURN position stays refused, Order 29) shapes the values' spelling — a helper returning one names the concrete type. Paper in Order 32 (lane ui-32), the surface ruled before the build
items.status: OPEN — the owner's ask (2026-09-11); paper first (Order 32, lane ui-32), then the ruling, then the build
items.body:
**What exists.** `trait Slot { fun place(self, parent: View) }` at `browser/ui.vl:936` (process twin `process/ui.vl:379`, kept in step) with six arms: `View` (:941), `str` (:948), `Source` (:962, reactive text), `List` (:975, a static run — A46's fragment walks through it), `Source` (:1007, replace the element) and `Source>` (:1032, replace the run). `View::child` (:208) is the one universal child position; element syntax lowers every `{x}` hole to it. So a signal in child position needs NO special handling today — B268's root fix was in impl selection (a bound's arguments were dropped), not a child-position rule. `when` (:540), `swap` (:592) and `bind_each` (:342, with `bind_each_values` :421 and `bind_each_by` :452) are METHODS on the parent: each captures `self.element` and appends what it builds, and each returns `self` for the chain. `std::dom` has `append` (:158) and `append_text` (:163) and no `insert_before`, no comment node — which is why every reactive arm and every method appends (the `Source` arm's own comment says so: 'put it last, or wrap it in an element of its own'). **The ask, restated.** Three things, one mechanism. (1) A fragment as one child: `List` already is (the static arm), A46's `<>..` is its literal; what it lacks is a stable POSITION when the list is reactive. (2) A positional conditional: `
{brand}{when(logged_in, || account_menu())}{footer}
` — today the `when` is a method on `nav`, its content appends after `footer`, and the fix is a wrapper `` whose only job is to hold the position. (3) A positional keyed run: `
    {header_row}{bind_each(items, key, row)}
` — same story, the rows land after the header only while nothing else follows them. All three are 'a child that owns a RUN of sibling nodes and keeps its place': a start marker (an empty text node or a comment) inserted at `place` time, and every later insertion done BEFORE it. **The design to paper.** (a) The primitive (= A71, build it first and as this item's brick): `dom.vl` gains `create_comment(text): Node` (or reuses `create_text_node("")`, :34) and `Element::insert_before(child: Element, anchor: Node)`; a small `Region { anchor: Node, live: Shared> }` helper in `ui.vl` that a Slot impl creates at `place` time, inserts its content before, and clears on dispose — the ambient owner's `defer` disposes it with the boundary, exactly as `bind_each` defers its rows today. (b) The values: free functions `when>(condition: S, body: (sync || View) context owner_scope): Conditional`, `swap>(source: S, render: (sync |T| View) context owner_scope): Swap`, `each>>(source: S, key: sync |T| K, render: ..): Each` (+ the `_values`/`_by` siblings, A42), each a struct with `impl .. with Slot` whose `place(parent)` creates the region and runs the method's existing body against it. The parent METHODS stay as one-line sugar (`fun when(self, ..): View { self.child(when(..)) }`) — no migration, no breaking change; the docs steer to the value form where position matters. (c) The reactive arms (`Source`, `Source>`) take the same region, which closes A71's 'put it last' honestly. (d) SSR twin: the region renders its current content in place; the anchor renders as nothing (a comment is acceptable if hydration ever needs it — say which and why). (e) Ownership: unchanged — rows and bodies under fresh owners, the region under the enclosing boundary. **The type question the owner raised.** A trait in child position is the UNIVERSAL bound (`child`) and needs nothing new. A trait in RETURN position — `fun footer(): Slot` — is the existential, and B253 (Order 29) RULED it stays refused: vilan has no opaque-type kind and no trait objects (trait-objects.md, ratified 2026-08-07). So a helper that returns one of these values spells the concrete type: `fun account(): Conditional>`. The paper must weigh that cost against the exhibits (a kolt census of helpers that would return a positional slot, read-only); if it is unbearable in practice, B253 reopens on THAT exhibit — not before, and not as a prerequisite of this item. **Fragments (A46).** The literal `<>..` lowering to a `List` stays A46's build; with (c) a `Source>` holding fragments keeps position, which was the half A46's recommendation left unsolved. A46's 'a component returns multiple roots' (a fragment that moves and dies as a unit) is exactly a `Region` value — this item's (a)+(b) is the L-sized design A46 refused in v1, priced. **Deliverables.** Order 32 lane ui-32 builds (a) as A71 and writes this paper (`proposal/positional-slots.md`: the value forms' names and signatures, the region's dispose story, the SSR twin, B253's spelling cost with the census, A46's interplay, the migration of the three methods to sugar, and the wrapper elements the form removes from kolt — count them). The owner rules the surface; the build is the order after.
